label: Production
lead: Led by Susann · visuals by Shaq

text: Kickoff meeting, then Chichi, Susann and Eliud split off with their teams.
Writers get about 3 hours for the full script, then send it to the actors, the DOP and the group.
The call sheet and shot list come straight from the script. Actors rehearse while everyone else sources props and wardrobe and sets up the locations.
Writers text Sesilia (the timekeeper) their exact start and stop times.
The whole script is finished before we shoot, so wardrobe, makeup and lighting don't get redone scene by scene.
Any spare production hours go to post.
Editors start assembling while we're still shooting.
Kids work a maximum of 6 hours.
Nap when your department is idle.
The call sheet gets updated every day: roles, times per scene, the weather and the nearest hospital.
